title: Ordinary strict tensor-model and evaluation comparison data
statement: For a small site $\mathcal C$, a commutative ring sheaf $R$, its module category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and strict algebra towers [def-weil-inverse-system], [def-sf-localized-strict-tensor-comparison-data], use the existing ordinary direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and strict reduction $T_S(P)$ [def-sf-strict-tensor-reduction-termwise]. Define the following comparison data, without asserting existence. An ordinary evaluation datum at level $n\ge1$ consists of cochain isomorphisms $e_n\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes B)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(e_nA\otimes e_nB)$, natural in both strict diagram complexes, whose map on each total-degree summand is the identity on local pure tensors. An ordinary tensor-model datum for $S$ consists of cochain isomorphisms $\operatorname{Tot}(\Delta P\otimes S[0])\cong T_S(P)$, natural in $P$, sending the $(i,0)$ local generator $p\otimes s$ to $p\otimes s$. All tensors and section generators are the existing sheaf tensor followed by its sheafification unit; $S[0]$ is the actual degree-zero complex. The target is the actual strict tower with differential $d_P\otimes1$ and transitions $1\otimes s_n$, not merely separate derived objects.
